item.title: Redington Grande Super Torque 10wt
item.description: Worst reel I have ever owned. I primarily fly fish the salt. Everything from snook, reds, permit, tarpon, bonefish, etc. I live in SFL and spend a lot of time in warm hot humid conditions. Belize, Mexico, Bahamas, USVIs, etc.I have never had a worse reel.

item.title: Use Birds to Quickly Locate Bait and Schools of Fish
item.description: Certain times of the year in both freshwater and saltwater, anglers can use flocks of actively feeding birds to locate large concentrations of bait and fish. This was the case during my recent fly fishing trip with Capt. Joel Dickey.

item.title: The Best Fly Patterns to Catch a Grand Slam
item.description: Catching a true grand slam—a permit, bonefish, and tarpon in a single day—is the epitome of saltwater fly fishing. Many anglers go their whole saltwater careers chasing a slam, traveling to far-off destinations in search of pristine habitat and abundant opportunities. One common destination to check off a grand slam is Belize.

item.title: Belize’s Most Overlooked Fish
item.description: Most fly anglers head to Belize in search of the big three: bonefish, permit, and tarpon. In terms of saltwater fly fishing, it’s one of the best locations to consistently have opportunities at a grand slam.

item.title: Meet the Crew: Alexandra Nicole
item.description: Anglers Alexandra Nicole and Alec Lucas head to Belize for season 2 of Coast 2 Coast. Their goal is to explore the different parts of the country, from shallow water flats to backwater lagoons, in search of the hardest thing to do in saltwater fly fishing: catch a grand slam (permit, bonefish, and tarpon).

item.title: Being There
item.description: I’VE BEEN ASKED A HUNDRED TIMES HOW I TOOK THIS PHOTO. THE ANSWER IS REALLY SIMPLE. I took several years. I had this idea in my head for a long time. I wanted to show the pure mayhem of a jumping tarpon. I wanted tell the whole story. The power, the speed, the violence of it, but also the story of a great guide and angler working together.

item.title: The Double Figure 8 Loop knot
item.description: Loop knots give your fly superior action in the water. There are several good options for creating a loop knot but tied in heavy salt water tippet, like you use for tarpon, most get quite bulky. In the first of three videos on better salt water knots, Capt. Joel Dickey shows us how to tie the Double Figure 8 Loop Knot.

item.title: Not a bad day, not a bad day at all
item.description: We really are blessed in South Florida. I caught a largie, a few peacock and had a go at a couple snook and chucked my fly at a huge rolling tarpon (relative too fish around, it was probably 60-80lbs) all in the same canal.

item.title: Two for one Lepomis

item.title: Bruce Chard’s Palolo Worm
item.description: THE PALOLO WORM HATCH IN THE FLORIDA KEYS TRULY MUST BE SEEN TO BE BELIEVED. Tarpon go completely crazy when these bright red worms pour out of the sand by the millions. The fish gorge themselves on worms and quite a few of those worms are cleverly tied imitations. It’s the fishing opportunity of a lifetime.

item.title: First deer hair fly
item.description: I want to catch one of these big Florida grass carp on the fly so I bought some dog biscuit flies, but I wasn’t feeling good about trying to land a 15-40lb grass carp on those tiny ahh hooks. So I tried to tie one up on a sz 6 mustad tarpon streamer hook. I think it turned out alright. Just trimmed it up with my regular straight tying scissors.

item.title: How Louis Got His Groove Back

item.title: One Fly, One Cast, One Tarpon
item.description: The bow of the skiff rises and falls under my feet as my eyes scan the vast expanse of blue and green. We call this riding the bull. Balancing on a casting platform as the boat bobs and shifts in the surf. Out on the ocean side, that’s where you find migrating tarpon. These big fish push past in schools, often single file.

item.title: From Tarpon to Techniques: Chasing Saltwater Dreams
item.description: Saltwater fly fishing is like casting a line into the very essence of adventure itself. As I sift through stories from fellow anglers, it’s clear that every cast brings with it not just the promise of a fish, but a world filled with unforgettable experiences. From the exhilarating strikes of giant Tarpon in the glistening waters off Costa Rica, to the vibrant chaos of sardines frenzied along the beaches of Baja California, each tale reminds me that the ocean’s pulse is alive and waiting for us to engage.

item.title: Chasing Silver Dreams: The Allure of Saltwater Fly Fishing Adventures
item.description: Ah, that unmistakable thrill when the sun-kissed horizon meets the shimmering surface of the ocean. Saltwater fly fishing is not just about the catch; it’s an adventure steeped in the salty breeze and the promise of epic battles against nature’s finest. Whether you’re casting a line in the tropical shallows of La Paz or the wild coasts of Costa Rica, each location offers a unique canvas for your fishing story. Fresh reports from fellow anglers remind us that every cast can lead to both mistakes and triumphs, and it’s in those moments that we discover what it truly means to be a saltwater fly fisherman.

item.title: Chasing the Grand Slam: Mastering the Saltwater Flats Experience
item.description: As we dive into the exhilarating world of saltwater fly fishing, we can’t help but feel the thrill that comes with targeting species like tarpon, bonefish, and permit—collectively known as the Grand Slam. Our exploration of this unique fishing environment, from the stunning flats of La Paz to Costa Rica’s rich waters, showcases techniques that not only enhance our skills but also deepen our appreciation for the sport. Anglers everywhere are discovering that the saltwater experience is about much more than just the catch; it’s about embracing the vibrant ecosystems and the sheer unpredictability of the ocean’s offerings.

item.title: Chasing Silver Kings: Our Guide to Tarpon Adventures
item.description: As we dive into the exhilarating world of tarpon fishing, we find ourselves captivated by the incredible stories and insights shared by fellow anglers. From the thrill of battling the ‘silver king’ in Costa Rica to the humbling experience of learning on the beach with a simple fly rod, the journey of targeting tarpon is one filled with highs and lows that unite us all as fishermen. In one Reddit post, a seasoned angler shares the joys of what they call a ‘giant tarpon day,’ while another recounts their rookie experience that sparked an unquenchable thirst for saltwater fishing. These narratives remind us that every great angler starts somewhere, and it’s the pursuit of these majestic fish that binds our community together.

item.title: Mastering the Flats: Saltwater Fly Fishing Techniques and Adventures
item.description: As we dive into the exhilarating world of saltwater fly fishing, it’s clear that the flats present both unique challenges and unforgettable rewards. From the adrenaline rush of landing a giant tarpon in Costa Rica to the strategic nuances of targeting bonefish and permit, our exploration of these articles reveals the depth of skill and knowledge required to truly excel in saltwater environments. Whether you’re a seasoned angler or just wading into the world of saltwater fly fishing, there’s a wealth of insights to glean from the experiences shared by fellow anglers.

item.title: Chasing the Big Ones: A Saltwater Fly Fishing Odyssey
